cohort: The study participants were 30,940 (weighted) Bangladeshi women aged between 15 and 49 years.
finding: The study found a prorich inequality in the use of facility delivery in Bangladesh, which increased from 14.48% in 2007 to 49.26% in 2017-2018, with socioeconomic factors being major contributors.
cross-section timing: Data was analyzed from the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey between 2007 and 2017-2018.
